title: ID0404013-DC/SI-D/ES[170000133] - Chademo not charging
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Chademo not charging
Root cause:
Possible wrong config in max power, should be 60kW
Solution:
Change SCB configuration to max power of the first converter group (3 converters = Max Power 60kW, if 2 converters Max Power = 40kW)
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
No
Warranty Status:
Expired

Problem Description
: Chademo is not charging since 13th October 2024
Troubleshooting
: I checked the logs and found that after this date there was only “one session” on the 19th October, afterwards there has been no more attempts at charging this outlet:
On the 19th there is this start session because one customer chose the wrong outlet ID, they wanted to charge with CCS (ID:1) and selected the Chademo (ID:3), that's why we see a start session even though it didn't go through all the steps.
On the 13th October, the session worked perfectly, so I don't see a reason why it shouldn't work.
Let me know if this information is what you needed.
For future reference, your case number is
0404013
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: ID0404013-DC/SI-D/ES[170000133] - Chademo not charging CRM:00315002317
additional_info.body:
Hi Fernando,
I changed the Max Power for the Chademo from 100kW to 60kW, this is because there is a limitation from charger's point of view that if you have a dynamic system, it doesn't allow the Chademo to go to full maximum, Chademo can handle 200A at 500V (500V is static and current variable), but with our system it can only provide 125A, so 125*500=62.5kW which is the first group with 3 converters = 60kW.
Let's retry again the sessions and if it works, we have a solution.
Best regards,
Francisco
